ينعصر (form VII)
# يَنْعَصِرُ (yanʕaṣiru) /jan.ʕa.sˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# يُنْعَصَرُ (yunʕaṣaru) /jun.ʕa.sˤa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# يَنْعَصِرَ (yanʕaṣira) /jan.ʕa.sˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# ي
